title: MS_POC
summary: A KYC onboarding web app that an agent tests, turning findings into Jira stories.

branches.name: App under test
branches.summary: A browser app the agent drives to check every skill.

children.name: kyc_app.py
children.detail: Standard-library web server on port 8000. Analysts log in, create applications, verify documents, run sanctions screening, then approve, escalate or reject.

children.name: Decision rules
children.detail: Approval needs all documents verified and a clear screening result. High-risk cases must be escalated first. Sanctions hits can never be approved.

branches.name: Agent skills
branches.summary: Agent skills that automate the work.

children.name: Orchestrator
children.detail: Opens the app URL in a browser and exercises each skill, recording what passes and what fails.

children.name: create-jira-stories
children.detail: Skill wrapper that runs jira_import.py to turn the findings file into Jira work.

children.name: project-mindmap
children.detail: Reads the project, writes mindmap.json, builds the HTML and screenshots it with Playwright.

branches.name: Jira integration
branches.summary: Creates the board, epics and stories in Jira Cloud.

children.name: jira_import.py
children.detail: Reads the backlog file and calls the Jira REST API to create the project, epics, stories, dependency links, a filter and a Scrum board. Re-runs skip anything already created.

children.name: Jira Cloud
children.detail: Receives the issues and shows them on a Scrum board.

branches.name: Data and config
branches.summary: Files the other parts read and write.

children.name: stories.json
children.detail: The backlog: epics, stories, priorities, acceptance criteria and dependencies.

children.name: .env
children.detail: Holds JIRA_BASE_URL, JIRA_EMAIL and JIRA_API_TOKEN. Never commit it.

children.name: import state
children.detail: Maps backlog ids to Jira keys so a failed import can resume.

flow: The orchestrator opens the KYC app URL and exercises each skill.
Findings are written to stories.json as epics and stories.
jira_import.py loads credentials from .env and checks them against Jira.
It creates the project, epics, stories and dependency links, then a Scrum board.
Progress is saved to the state file so a re-run only does what is missing.
